notes.title: 1.0.2 updated & Another Bug Fix on the way.
notes.notes:
We have updated v1.0.1 and v1.0.2 this weekend.
Which were minor bug fixes and updates as following : 
- Opening scene button click fix
- Some achievements not working fix.
- Minor UI change

In v1.0.2 we have found a critical bug that was not on the initial release.
which are as following :
- Some stages are opening other stages in Revolver, Zodiac chapters.

Sorry for the inconvenience. This next fix is on the way and we are working swiftly to not cause any lag in game playing.

+ We think gamers and developers work together to build a game. We are open to all feedbacks. Feel free to give us any changes you want in the game!
Thank you
